INTRO
Get a glimpse of campus life in your pocket! WesternU Mobile is your ticket to the Western University experience. Hungry and want to know where to eat? Did you just bike to campus and find yourself in desperate need of a shower? Maybe you’re planning to attend the upcoming Mustangs game or want to catch up on campus news? For this and more, WesternU Mobile has you covered.

MAPS
We’re excited to announce that we have improved the map experience - and we’ve included new maps! New maps include:
Athletics and varsity venues
Performing arts venues and galleries
Faculty main office locations
Public showers
Bike racks
Additionally, we’ve improved access to the new maps by creating an easy-to-use selector tool

BUG FIXES
We are working to improve the WesternU Mobile experience. If you encounter any bugs or issues, please send them to mobile-apps@uwo.ca. 

Please note that one thing we’re looking into currently is improving how the Exam Schedule and Course Schedule modules work. Both modules only pull information for Undergraduate students. For exams, know that only those undergraduate exams entered into the central calendar will appear. If you have an exam that isn’t showing up, you should talk to your academic advisor for more info. To help those who miss this message, when you try to log in, you’ll now see a message similar to this that describes some issues you may face and how to overcome them.

FEEDBACK
Please continue to leave a review and offer feedback as we read everything submitted and go through the reviews left here as well. We are aware of issues some users are having relating to the app crashing or missing exam and course schedules and are looking into them.
